items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because the band was formed so quickly. They had to have some music.

ctx.x: He was dancing, man, to set up. He was right in the line of fire. He was definitely right there with his strong self. Knock out a couple of them. He was really strong about out there. He was really strong about out there. He had a good idea.
Well what sort of arrangements did you have for saxes? Well when we first started, they had Stockerman.
Because the band was formed so quickly. They had to have some music.
